continuity.campaign_development: November 60 BCE: Valerius ordered every soldier, including himself and his officers, to perform the same exercises, with officers required to meet or exceed the standard of the men under their command. The shared training exposed command weaknesses, a real security alarm interrupted an exercise, and one officer became temporarily unavailable from training strain before recovering by month's end. Intelligence rose from 977 to 983; end-of-round temporary unavailable returned to 0, with no treasury or supply change.
